images.title: Long Island — bridge baseline
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied standard Long Island city concept. Make ONLY ONE LOCAL GEOGRAPHY CHANGE: open its small leisure harbour to the surrounding sea and carry the existing coast road across the new entrance on a visible bridge. This is image 1 of a controlled style comparison; preserve the overall layout and the original standard image's moderately rich natural daylight colours exactly, not the more saturated darker colour variant.

Locate the SMALL MARINA BASIN in the near-left side of the island, immediately left of the round magenta-fronted entertainment building and above-left of the large foreground retail car parks. It currently reads as enclosed by the continuous outer coast road. Cut a SHORT, CLEAR, BLUE-WATER ENTRANCE CHANNEL through the coastal strip at the basin's near/southwestern edge, between that small marina and the open foreground-left sea. The basin and sea must visibly be the SAME CONNECTED WATER, not two pools separated by a solid land dam. Make the opening wide enough to read clearly in this whole-island overview, roughly a few small-boat widths. Do NOT cut through another district or turn this into a long canal.

Replace ONLY the coast-road segment crossing that opening with a SINGLE SHORT STRAIGHT BRIDGE. A simple low steel-girder road bridge with slim parapets and stone abutments on the two banks, two-way traffic and sidewalks, the deck at the same elevation as adjacent flat land. No high arch, suspension towers, ramps or elevation changes on the island. The slim suspended bridge deck spans OVER the water; visible dark-blue channel water immediately on both sides and under its open span makes the harbour connection unmistakable. Show the girder/open shadow gap above water rather than a solid causeway, seawall or dam. The bridge connects two points on THIS SAME ISLAND, never to mainland or another island. One bridge only. Do not add boat gameplay.

Preserve ALL ELSE: exact camera and landscape framing, complete elongated island silhouette, campus and sports fields at the far-left end, larger downtown in the upper-right centre, old port quarter around the small marina, rounded entertainment building, housing areas, warehouse/repair area, foreground big shops with large surface car parks, near-right shipping docks and cranes, all other roads, buildings, vegetation, general scale, ordinary architectural identity and original sunlight/material treatment. Do not redesign, rotate, crop or enlarge the city. No new high-rises, roads, districts, labels, logos, UI or map markings. Restore smooth original image quality, not quantization grain. Landscape output at least 1600 pixels wide.

images.title: Tideprint
images.prompt:
Create a RADICALLY RESTYLED 3D VIDEO GAME ENVIRONMENT. Art direction: BOLD INK TOON. The supplied image is ONLY a city map and camera reference. Preserve its overall map: elongated island upper-left to lower-right; university playing fields at upper-left; dense tall downtown upper-right; older harbour quarter at near-left; curved residential streets between; three large shop/car-park complexes foreground; warehouses and cranes far right. Keep the small marina and its ONE low road bridge with open water underneath at near-left; the bridge joins the same island, never mainland. Keep full island in frame, flat land, surrounding sea and the same broad aerial perspective. Preserve the layout and relative district sizes, not the individual window patterns, trees, cars, or exact building model designs.
Discard the reference's realistic miniature-city rendering completely. Rebuild every asset with big chunky graphic shape design and at least 80% fewer small details. Use conspicuous thick DARK PLUM SILHOUETTE OUTLINES and STRICT TWO-TONE CEL SHADING across buildings and trees; NO smooth realistic shading, PBR reflection, ambient occlusion gradients or realistic texture. Roofs become clean broad ink-like polygons, windows only a handful of large grouped rectangles per facade. Use an original tightly art-directed palette: dark plum/indigo roads and sea, warm chalk buildings, vivid burnt-orange roof planes, muted cyan architecture and acid-yellow small vehicles. Trees dark teal simple geometric canopies, not realistic green leaves. The campus field is teal-green, the circular entertainment roof burnt-orange, the shops cyan and coral, the towers alternate dark indigo and warm chalk.
This is a flat-colour non-photorealistic 3D GAME RENDER, with coherent geometry/perspective and daylight shadows, not a poster, print texture or 2D map. The game's identity should be instantly readable from a thumbnail, like a bold graphic novel made into a 3D world, with no named-artist or franchise imitation. Quiet dark driving corridors, clean readable small cars, broad sidewalks. Every district and bridge retained, but DO NOT copy the original pale detailed buildings and simply add a filter. No labels, UI, text, grain, halftone or night lighting. Landscape at least 1600px wide.
Lighting override for this variant: strongly graphic hard SUNLIT DAYTIME, sharp purple two-tone shadows, near-white key light, no soft realistic bounce gradients. Overall frame dominated by near-black plum, chalk, vermilion and mustard, with very little green or realistic blue sea. Push contrast and the printlike toon shader dramatically.
The owner explicitly requests DRASTIC differences in art style, palette, shading and lighting. Do not retain the original rendering treatment. Only preserve overall layout and the harbour bridge. Aim for a thumbnail-level transformation.

images.title: Stormwash
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Transform the reference into a DRASTICALLY DIFFERENT original 3D VIDEO GAME ART STYLE called STORMWASH. This is the atmospheric, hand-painted, nearly monochromatic extreme of a four-style comparison. Previous attempts clung to the reference's realistic colourful miniature-city appearance: DO NOT do that. Rebuild the visual appearance completely.

Preserve ONLY overall layout/camera/geography: elongated flat island from upper-left university/sports fields to near-right docks; large downtown upper-right; old port and marina middle-left; foreground three big retail buildings with surface car parks; mid-island housing; workshop sheds right; original curved street arrangement. Full island and all district masses in same approximate positions. Retain the SINGLE short low road bridge across the marina's near-left mouth, with visibly connected water flowing below from basin to open sea. No bridges to mainland, new island, hills, terraces or layout redesign.

ART: clearly hand-painted stylized 3D, solid low-detail conventional building meshes with broad painterly albedo shapes and confidently simplified silhouettes. Roofs are large quietly angular forms with two or three conspicuous DRY-BRUSH STROKES and deliberately irregular edge highlights. Towers simplified into tall sculptural slabs with a few large irregular painted window groups, NO realistic fine window grids or reflections. Roof and facade colour variation belongs to each object, not a filter laid over the screen. Broad hand-painted texture should be visible from this distance. Slightly exaggerated stout eaves, sparse dark simple trees, a clean readable bridge silhouette. True 3D volume, occlusion and coherent realtime-friendly lighting, not a 2D illustration.

PALETTE OVERRIDE IS MANDATORY: remove ALL naturalistic orange/cream/green/red/pastel buildings. Almost the entire city, ground and sea should live in a restrained family of CHARCOAL BLUE, STORM GREY, MUTED PETROLEUM GREEN and CHALK WHITE. Chalk dry-brush roof edges and pale slate wall patches pick out silhouettes. ONLY a few tiny signal-yellow accents on cranes, car clusters and selected sign panels. No coral, no terracotta, no normal bright green trees, no realistic blue ocean. Campus field a muted grey-green. Shops are dark grey-blue broad roofs, dock sheds pale grey/teal. Handpainted style remains rich and dimensional through value and warm/cool grey variations, not multicolour.

LIGHTING OVERRIDE: brooding heavily OVERCAST MIDDAY after rain, very soft cool sky illumination, no direct warm sun, no sunset and no night. Wet dark road surfaces with restrained pale sky reflections but clear crisp road borders and visible bright little vehicles. Subtle soft haze only far beyond the island, none hiding streets. Calm almost flat grey-green sea with widely spaced long chalk-painted wave strokes, NOT dense photoreal ocean. Clear readable medium-dark values rather than crushed black shadows. No glowing buildings or lamps.

This must be unmistakably different from the source and from a bright toy city, cel-shaded comic world or low-poly jewel city. It should plausibly be built as a gritty-in-MOOD but CLEAN hand-painted 3D game environment using low-frequency painted textures, simple meshes and atmospheric daytime lighting. No grime/noisy fine detail, outlines, toon bands, paper/canvas border, labels, UI, text, real brands or signature. Landscape at least 1600 pixels wide.
